summary: RE-REVIEW after the rebase onto #944 (e8ed74a2). The pin at 311d2f50 is void and its record is deleted in this same commit. Rebase integrity proven rather than assumed: I stripped blob-hash and hunk-offset lines from both diffs and compared the 868 changed content lines directly — BYTE-IDENTICAL to the diff I reviewed. No file overlap with what landed: #945 touches confirmation_exit.py, db/models.py, services/schwab_1m_v2_bot.py, settings.py and strategy_core/schwab_1m_v2.py, none of which are the oms/service.py, broker_adapters/webull.py or broker_eligibility.py set that #944 and #946 merged. MIGRATION CHAIN CHECKED, a risk that only appears on a rebase: #945 carries 20260910_0020 with down_revision 20260904_0019; neither #944 nor #946 added a migration, there is no duplicate down_revision anywhere in versions/, and no forked alembic head. Ancestor test PASS against base e8ed74a2; all three commits carry exactly one recognised agent marker, authored by codex, so reviewer differs from every author in the range. All four of my original findings re-verified BY CONTENT on the rebased head, not carried over: the un-flagged resting_entry stamp is still absent from the Webull fan-out draft (the key now appears only on the three Schwab paths), webull_account_not_configured and fanout_identity_source_disabled are both present as fail-closed configuration checks, and the source_fill_id fallback with fanout_slot_id backfill is intact. Mutations re-run on the rebased head against tests/unit/test_confirmation_exit.py + test_v2_dual_broker_fanout.py (68 passed baseline), all eight independently RED: Webull shape rejected by the predicate -> 5 failed; drop account widening -> 4; drop missing-slot_id fail-closed -> 1; drop Schwab-representative preference -> 1; flag default flipped ON -> 4; drop webull-account config check -> 1; drop identity-source check -> 1; drop source_fill_id fallback -> 2. Controlled full unit pair vs the NEW base e8ed74a2: base 46 failed/3576 passed, head 46 failed/3591 passed, ZERO new failure names and ZERO fixed, compared as sorted sets. Ruff clean on src+tests. SHIPS DARK: strategy_schwab_1m_v2_confirmation_account_neutral_discovery_enabled defaults False, and a mutation flipping that default turns 4 controls red. ENABLEMENT CONSTRAINT FOR THE DEPLOY NOTE, verified in code: the flag is read from self.settings, which is built once at schwab_1m_v2_bot.py:259 and never reloaded, so enabling it REQUIRES a strategy-service restart — which necessarily also activates the merged #943 lifecycle behaviour. Per the operator's plan, #945 merges dark now and is enabled only when the corrected #943 deploys.
